title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookie Bars
changes_from_base: A one-bowl chewy oatmeal cookie bar with raisins and a thin icing drizzle, instead of shortbread, caramel and chocolate.
summary: Chewy molasses oatmeal bars with raisins and a simple icing drizzle.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
warm water, plus extra as needed

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan), shelf in the centre, and grease and line the 20 cm tin.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the brown sugar, butter and treacle together, then whisk in the egg and vanilla.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Add the flour, oats, cinnamon, baking powder and salt and stir with a spatula until no dry streaks remain, then stir in the raisins.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread evenly and bake 25-30 min, until evenly browned and set in the centre (about 96 °C inside). Cool completely on a rack.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Whisk the icing sugar with 2 tsp water, adding drops more until it flows like honey. Drizzle over and let it set 5-10 min before cutting into 16.

tips: Soak the raisins in hot water for 5 min if they are dry.
Do not overbake; they firm up as they cool.
Add the water to the glaze a drop at a time.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
